names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Νικόλαος που μαρτύρησε στη Μαγνησία», with the rank word left off; the place of his martyrdom is kept in the English form because it is the day's own way of telling him apart.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 24. април ст. ст., „Св. новомуч. Лука и Никола.“, with „Св.“ and the rank новомуч., which stands over both names, left off. The heading gives him no city — Magnesia, which this corpus's English name keeps, is saint.gr's — so the bare forename is all of it, and it is the **Serbian** vernacular Никола where most of this corpus's Nicholases are the Russian Николай. What that folds onto was measured and is in the batch's commit message.

birth.note: saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Νικολαος Που Μαρτυρησε Στη Μαγνησια (1754 - 1776)»; the body of the page gives no year of birth, only that he was twenty-two when he went to Magnesia.

death.note: saint.gr: «παρέδωσε το πνεύμα του, το έτος 1776 μ.Χ. (κατ' άλλους 1769 μ.Χ ή 1796 μ.Χ)» — the page prints three years and settles none of them, so the interval carries all three; its own heading gives 1776.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Νικόλαος που μαρτύρησε στη Μαγνησία»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page names his town Yaya Köy, his father Hadji-Kanelos, steward of the estates of the aga Kara Osumanoglou, and his age of twenty-two; it gives his answer to the judge of Magnesia and the four floggings he bore, and says he died in prison. **It prints three years for his death and settles none of them**, «το έτος 1776 μ.Χ. (κατ' άλλους 1769 μ.Χ ή 1796 μ.Χ)», so the interval here carries all three; its own heading gives 1754 to 1776. It names no relic and prints no hymn. The corpus keeps many saints named Nicholas; the epithet in the English form is the day's own way of telling this one apart.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.05.2026 (24. април ст. ст.) — „Св. новомуч. Лука и Никола.“

attestations.note: The entry gives this martyr **a name, a rank and a year and nothing else** — „а Никола 1776. год.“ — so the identification rests on those three and on the day: a new martyr called Nicholas, dead 1776, commemorated on this menologion day, which is the folder saint.gr keeps on 24 April and heads «(1754 - 1776)». The corpus holds no other Nicholas new martyr on this day. It is a thin call and is written as one.
